1. (Currently amended) A method for restoring efficiency of a photovoltaic cell that has undergone light-induced degradation, the method comprising: illuminating the photovoltaic cell such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least 5 hours of solar illumination; and annealing the photovoltaic cell at a temperature above 90 degrees Celsius for a minimum of 10 minutes, wherein the annealing is performed after the illuminating step.

2. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises a semiconductor wafer, and the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least 20 hours of solar illumination during the illuminating step.

3. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature above 130 degrees Celsius, and wherein the annealing step further comprises simultaneously illuminating the photovoltaic cell such that the photovoltaic cell receives additional time integrated irradiance during the annealing step.

4. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 3, wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least 10 minutes of solar illumination during the simultaneous illuminating and annealing step.

5. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the semiconductor wafer is a silicon semiconductor wafer.

6. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature between 140 degrees Celsius and 210 degrees Celsius for a minimum of 2 hours.

7. (Original) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is a thin film photovoltaic cell.

8. (Original) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is an amorphous silicon thin film photovoltaic cell.

9. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated and annealed after manufacturing of the photovoltaic cell is complete such that the photovoltaic cell produces electricity when illuminated.

10. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated with a light source that simulates solar radiation from the sun.
